prompt: Create ONE dignified somber painted bust portrait for conversation scenes in the Japanese Sengoku action game Sekigahara Ranbu. SUBJECT SANADA YUKIMURA using attached approved game character sheet as strict identity reference: same face, age, red lacquered armor, gold details, same antler crested kabuto helmet, six coin crest, hair/facial hair exactly as reference. This is CLOSE-UP chest-up three-quarter portrait, gaze slightly RIGHT toward conversation partner. Strong calm resolve, weathered human face, restrained mouth, no exaggerated screaming. Rich realistic Japanese historical portrait painting with subtle brushwork and sumi ink edges, muted deep red charcoal warm oldpaper highlights, dramatic soft directional light, tasteful and rugged 渋い. Anatomy and armor historically practical. Do NOT copy standing sheet layout. Single character only, no weapon crossing face, antlers helmet shoulders entirely included with margins, portrait framed from midchest upward. No labels letters calligraphy seals border decorative frame no scenery. Transparent background, clean cutout silhouette for overlay on dialogue background. Keep face bright and legible at game UI scale, painted rather than photography, match approved identity. 3:4 vertical composition high quality.
